verdict.rationale: Greptile documents custom rules for team-specific issues and a repo-level greptile.json that overrides dashboard settings. It also supports patterns that can be viewed and created via MCP, and it imports existing rule files (Claude.md, AGENTS.md, cursor.rules) as review context. Together these cover encoding natural-language team guidelines that the reviewer applies. Missing for 10: no evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, no explicit support for linking external style-guide documents, thin detail on how strictly rules are enforced, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of rule enforcement.
